Needs changes before merge.

The new text agrees with the handler in PR #2077. The decision record explains the scope. The body has `Process change: yes`. This PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`, Rust code, UI code, or golden files.

Local checks:
- Trial merge with upstream/main `c86d6db351c863e5bbcd98dd278d667c452eb78d`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; 0 test steps, because no files in crates/ changed. The local xtask build passed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed.
- Rust test suites and clippy: not run; this PR changes documentation only.
- Mutations: not run. This PR does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision checks. No golden files changed.

Requested before merge:
1. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:113,122`: These rows tell agents to use inputs that current main does not support. PR #2077 is still open. On the trial merge, the MCP tool list has no `set_stock_material`, and `CuttingRowDto` does not accept `unknown` as a material. Merge #2077 first, then check these rows against main. If this documentation must merge first, mark the new inputs as pending #2077 and tell agents not to use them until that PR is merged. State the merge dependency in the PR body.

No other changes are requested. The process-version bump belongs to the merge batch, as the current process rules require.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the review finding about inputs that main does not support yet.

- `set_stock_material` is marked pending #2077. Agents are told not to use it until #2077 merges. Pin: `test_set_stock_material_pending_2077`.
- The `add_tool` row marks material `unknown` and optional `stepdown` / `stepover` as pending #2077. Agents are told not to use them until #2077 merges. Pin: `test_cutting_data_unknown_and_steps_pending_2077`.
- The PR body now states the merge dependency and requires checking the rows against main after #2077 merges. Pin: `test_pr_body_merge_dependency_2077`.

All three scratch pins passed. Each reverted notice or removed dependency section failed its pin. Restoring each fix passed again.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed (0 steps; no Rust crates changed). Diff checks passed. Clippy is not applicable because no Rust crates changed.

New head: 0f4175a2f7a483f4359aa52a992a538426e449bc.

Please re-review this head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The previous finding is resolved:
- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:113,122` marks the new inputs as pending PR #2077. Both rows tell agents not to use them until that PR is merged.
- The PR body states the merge dependency. It requires a check against main after #2077 merges, before removal of the restrictions.
- The planned inputs agree with the handler and data fields in PR #2077. That PR is still open.

Local checks in `.claude/worktrees/review-2089`:
- Trial merge with upstream/main `c86d6db351c863e5bbcd98dd278d667c452eb78d`: passed.
- Local xtask build: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; 0 test steps, 0 failures. Only two documentation files changed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed.
- Rust test suites and clippy: not run. No Rust crates changed.
- Mutations: not run. This PR does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No golden files changed.

No changes are requested. No UI files changed, so screenshots are not required. The body has `Process change: yes` and `Changelog: none`. The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION` or `CHANGELOG.md`. The current process rules assign the version change to the merge batch.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Correction to the review above (M5): point 1 is withdrawn. Upstream AGENTS.md (PROCESS_VERSION 76) says a process PR does NOT change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`; it carries the line `Process change: yes`, and the merging session bumps the number after the batch. This PR was right not to bump it. The reviewer read an older AGENTS.md.

Point 2 still stands: the skill rows document `set_stock_material` and the `cutting_data` keys that only exist in open PR #2077, so this PR should merge together with or right after #2077. It stays a draft with `needs-rework` until then. Please also add the line `Process change: yes` to the PR body if it is missing.

Addressed: the review's request 1 (bump `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`) is withdrawn. It used the old rule. Current AGENTS.md ("Process changes bump `PROCESS_VERSION` and are announced") says a process PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`. Its body has the line `Process change: yes`, and the merging session bumps the version. A re-review of this head is queued.

Needs changes before merge: one earlier request remains open.

The later `Addressed:` comment permits this review of the same head.

The process-version request is withdrawn and is not a finding. Current upstream/main `AGENTS.md` requires `Process change: yes` in the body. This PR has that line and correctly leaves `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` unchanged. The merging session changes the version after the batch.

The pending notices are clear. Both skill rows prohibit the new inputs until PR #2077 merges. The body states that dependency. The decision record explains the choice.

Local checks in `.claude/worktrees/review-2089`:
- Trial merge with upstream/main `a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504`: passed.
- Local xtask build: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; 2 documentation files changed, 0 test steps, 0 failures.
- The first gate attempt selected unrelated main changes because the trial merge was not committed. I stopped it. The result above uses the local trial merge commit.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed.
- Rust suites and clippy: not run. No Rust crates changed.
- Mutations: not run. This PR changes no posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry.
- No golden files or UI files changed. Screenshots are not required.

Requested before merge:
1. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:113,122`: The later review's request 2 remains open. PR #2077 is still open, and current main has no `set_stock_material` handler. Keep this PR as a draft until #2077 merges. Then check the rows against main and remove the pending notices. Alternatively, the reviewer who made request 2 can withdraw it in a comment. The correction comment withdrew only request 1 and explicitly kept request 2. Under current `AGENTS.md`, a clean review on the same head cannot override that open request.

No additional defects were found. The PR is `MERGEABLE`, but `needs-rework` remains because the earlier request is not resolved.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
